selection_policy.campaign: contracts, batch, portfolio, six suite reports, failure analyses
selection_policy.strict: complete hash-verifiable trace closure without duplicate render trees
selection_policy.failure: the only failed trajectory with paired observations and tool evidence
selection_policy.long_horizon: trace, task judgment, events, final answer, and resume checkpoint
excluded: content-addressed image blobs duplicated by paired images

restoration.command: for archive in archives/*.tar.gz; do tar -xzf "$archive"; done
restoration.note: Extract archives at the bundle root to restore hash-bound observation and tool-result paths before re-running artifact verification.

privacy_review.notice: Hash-bound evidence is copied byte-for-byte. Some records retain the non-secret local workspace paths emitted during the original run.
